note: Test-data defaults (engine/src/fixture-inputs.ts): every input a fixture case does not state takes its template's value here; null in a case withholds one. A default with "withheld" is left out where every test of its "when" holds on the case's other answers, stated or defaulted. "consistency" lists answers one filer cannot give together ("never"); the build refuses a case that takes a default against such a rule, but for what the rule lists as "open". The evaluator, the command-line program and the interview never read this file. Changing an existing value or withholding condition needs an acknowledged affected-cases report (tools/defaults_guard.mjs); adding a default for a new input needs only the normal tier. tools/README.md, "Test-data defaults".
